intro: Mining, fishing and tourism drive Namibia's economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Diamonds are dredged from the sea floor. Namibia is a major uranium producer, and fishing in the cold Benguela current is rich. Offshore oil has been discovered.

chapters.title: Green hydrogen
text: Namibia is planning green hydrogen projects using its sun and wind.
